storyInfo: Crownslayer is forbidden by Rhodes Island from going to Ursus, and returns to Nuova Volsinii in anger. While there, she makes a decision—

attributes.content: ...I'm sorry, Crownslayer, but we cannot approve your application to join us in Ursus.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Why not?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Dr. Kal'tsit left very specific instructions in case you ever brought this up.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I know Ursus better than anyone!
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Precisely. You know it too well.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: What's that supposed to mean?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: She said that if you got angry about this, that would prove her judgment correct. She made a special note on your transfer requests—you can go anywhere except Ursus.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: And why does she get to decide that for me? I'm not the little girl hiding behind her coat anymore. This isn't about revenge either!
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I just want to go home and find out how exactly my father died, and what exactly that damn Sarcophagus is! What's wrong with that?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Nothing at all. Here, she left you a recording.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Lyudmila, when you find yourself standing before the machine that devoured your father, when you find your childhood drawings... what do you plan to do then?
attributes.name: Kal'tsit's Audio Recording

attributes.content: My plan?
To find the truth.
You want the truth. But the truth is in the past; it belongs to history. What are your plans for what comes after?
attributes.name: Kal'tsit's Audio Recording

attributes.content: After I find out the truth?
Revenge, of course.
Naturally, you'll say you wish to become a slayer of crowns. But where exactly will you point your blade?
attributes.name: Kal'tsit's Audio Recording

attributes.content: My blade?
At the nobility already drowning in their politicking? At the ice-cold Sarcophagus? Or maybe... at you.
If all you seek is an answer, then await my return, and I will tell you everything I can.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit's Audio Recording

attributes.content: While there are still some matters that I cannot tell you, I can nonetheless guarantee that this will be more informative for you than any trip to Ursus.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit's Audio Recording

attributes.content: I expect this promise will be enough to dissuade you from returning to Ursus. Assuming you don't have something else in mind.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit's Audio Recording

attributes.content: If you do, I wish you luck in convincing Amiya.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit's Audio Recording

attributes.content: I—
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I'm sorry, Crownslayer. But just so you know, this wasn't just Dr. Kal'tsit's decision. The Doctor and I agreed with it as well.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: You have too many ties to the country, and I can't risk letting those interfere with Rhodes Island's operations.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: But I promise you, once Dr. Kal'tsit returns—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Fine, I get it!
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: So she's always off who-knows-where, letting this little bunny speak for her!
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Saying I'm not qualified? Hah! I know what she's implying. She thinks I'm courting death. She doesn't get me at all.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Yeah, our Lyudmila's no coward! Without you, Pitt would've been a pile of ash ages ago!
attributes.name: Truck Driver A

attributes.content: You know it! Does that Kal'tsit lady even know how to drive a truck? Does she have any idea what it takes to make it as a trucker?!
attributes.name: Truck Driver B

attributes.content: Didn't you say you know her secret or something? She's just afraid of you! She's scared of you spilling it next time you go back.
attributes.name: Truck Driver A

attributes.content: Hmph, exactly!
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Who gives a damn about those big-company paper-pushers anyway? They don't even see you as a person!
attributes.name: Truck Driver B

attributes.content: Yeah! C'mon, Lyudmila. Don't even waste your energy getting angry about it. Here, take this!
attributes.name: Truck Driver A

attributes.content: Thanks, Joe... This apple's pretty crunchy.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: 'Course it is. Traded for it straight from the farm just a little while ago.
attributes.name: Truck Driver A

attributes.content: A farm? When did we start working with farms?
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: While you were gone. We hooked up with some villages in the wastes. Relax, it's all legit.
attributes.name: Truck Driver A

attributes.content: Everyone's been talking about holding a barbecue today, and actually, we wanted you to be in charge—mostly so Eirene doesn't burn all the meat again.
attributes.name: Truck Driver B

attributes.content: Yeah... I'm thinking you guys just wanna steal some of my salt soda.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Heheh. But for real, Lyudmila! Stay and party with us for a bit. Forget all about that rotten Rhodes Island!
attributes.name: Truck Driver B

attributes.content: That—
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Talking behind my back, are we?
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: Just telling the truth, Eirine. Your BBQ skills can't hold a candle to hers.
attributes.name: Truck Driver B

attributes.content: How about you get back to work then? Unless you're telling me your soda party here is because you're already done for the day?
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: Fine, fine, I'm going.
attributes.name: Truck Driver A

attributes.content: So how long are you planning to stay this time, Lyudmila?
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: I've got a short field op coming up, so I'll be heading back in a few days.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Can't you stay any longer?
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: Don't worry, I'll be back. Not like I have anywhere else to go these days.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Here.
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: This is... a trucker's union 'Special Associate Agreement'?
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: '...As per this agreement, the Agenzia per la Sicurezza dei Trasporti will provide Lyudmila Ilyinichna a residence in Nuova Volsinii along with identification documents...'
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: You...
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: I know your situation's a little special. I've been thinking about this ever since you left last time.
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: Don't think of the contract as a chain, but as insurance.
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: Sign it, and you'll have a tie to Nuova Volsinii. Then, no matter what Rhodes Island does, you'll always have a truck and a bed here, if you want them.
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: Personally, I want you to stay. Not as a dispatch operator, but as family.
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: Family...
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: So why hesitate? Is it because...?
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: It's too good a deal.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: A legal identity, a group of passionate comrades, and a place to call my own, untouched by government plots or Originium explosives.
Just sign my name, and I'll have every legal right to remain here.
I can tell myself it's to protect Eirene, to help the AST fight off the famiglie... That's as righteous a motive as any.
I'd never have to worry about Ursus's freezing winds ever again, or Kal'tsit's damn question.
And I did tell Eirene I'd be watching her.
Lyudmila?
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: ...Grazie, Eirene. Really.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: But it's a lot to consider. I... I'll have to mull over it.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: No problem! I know it's a big decision. Keep the contract, and come find me whenever you're ready.
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: Now, let's go get some coffee. Old Sam just brewed a fresh batch. With extra sugar.
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: Sure.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: As Lyudmila watches Eirene walk away, she folds the contract and stuffs it into her inner chest pocket.
Sharing that pocket is also an old, crumpled map leading to the Ursus border.
Oh right, and we also got some new business partners.
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: Joe was telling me about that earlier. What about them?
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: How do I put it... Something about them worries me a bit.
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: What's that supposed to mean?
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: They said they came from a farm far away, so I did a background check. No problems there, and they're polite enough.
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: But some of their people reminded me of you. So I wanted to ask you to take a look.
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: How am I supposed to take that? Well, whatever, fine.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Let's see... The list is all daily necessities—nothing out of the ordinary.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: As for the goods themselves... all above board.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Is this the delivery address?
attributes.name: Lyudmila
Lyudmila
attributes.content: 'Susie's Groceries'? Sounds normal enough
...Red? Why are you...? Don't tell me—
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: I should be asking that.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: What've you done to the truckers, Lyudmila?!/What've you done to the grocers, Red?!
attributes.name: Red/Lyudmila

attributes.content: You're the driver?
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: You're the client?
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Those goods... They're ours.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: I'll help you.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Oh, and long time no see.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: You too.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: I'd heard the AST had this amazing Reproba who was away on a business trip, but I didn't think it'd be you.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Sounds like your journey home went well. Nine will be happy to hear that.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Nine, huh? So what's with the farm?
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: It's a farm.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: And Nine's there?
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Yup. With the others.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: And Talulah?
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: ...You'd probably kill someone if I didn't tell you. Yes, she's there too. Nine's watching her.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: So this shipment is stockpiling for—
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: We're preparing for the future.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Which is why we need so much.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Neither the Kazimierzians nor the Leithanians wanted to trade with us, so we tried our luck here. Never expected that judge or Commissioner Eirene would be so willing to help, though.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Because you hid your identities.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: And do you go around advertising your past in Reunion, Lyudmila?
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: We're just a group of farmers living by the Ursus border. That part's no lie.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: But... why?
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: What's your angle here, Red?
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Almost done moving the goods.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: I saw the inventory list, and there weren't any problems with the order. Thank Eirene for me.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: And I doubt we'll be seeing each other again anytime soon, so thank her for treating us so well, too.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Red!
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: It's for your own good. You're no longer part of Reunion.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Or are you implying you want to come back?
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: If so, then come with me. I'm sure Nine would love to see you again.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Nine and Talulah. If I agree to return, I'd definitely make it back to Ursus.
And Talulah... How many times have I regretted not watching her more closely? Failing to notice her descent into evil?
This is an opportunity.
You can think it over, Lyudmila. Reunion's different now. This time we're going back to help people.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: But are you still the same? Are you Lyudmila the truck driver now, or someone else?
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Do you actually want to come back to us, or are you just looking to hitch a ride like last time?
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: I was never hitching a ride!
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: If you say so.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Well, if you haven't already made up your mind, then we'd only be sending a lost ghost back to the ruins of Chernobog.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: I'm leaving. Keep your distance, lest you get run over.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Wait! Red!
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: That bastard...
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: I'm back, Maestro.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: She has continued to pay the rent for this room, keeping it spotless, just like it was before her master died.
From her pockets, she takes out her old map, the contract from Eirene, and lastly the invoice signed by Red.
Maestro... you told me not to go back to Ursus for revenge. That I was too weak, and knew too little.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: But how do I know when I've got the strength and knowledge to be ready?
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: You're angry. Because Kal'tsit rejected you? Because Red saw right through you?
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: Or are you thinking Eirene chose the worst possible time for her offer?
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: Kal'tsit doesn't know me at all! She thinks I'm just eager to die, that I have no goal in mind. And Red, what does he mean I'm just a hitchhiker?!
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: They're right. You were Reunion's 'Crownslayer'. Wherever Talulah pointed, you went.
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: Then you became a 'delivery expert'. Wherever Eirene needs something delivered, you drive.
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: Lyudmila, you're always jumping between different cars before any of them have reached their destination.
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: Reunion's, Rhodes Island's, and the truckers'...
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: Shut up! I spilled blood for those goals!
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: You spilled blood to prove you're part of a story. Because you're afraid that once it ends, or once you're out of the picture, you'll be nothing.
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: You fear that without the labels of 'avenger' or 'driver', you're just a gaping void.
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: I just want to know the truth. I want to pay my respects at my father's grave!
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Your legs are your own. If you really wanted to, who could stop you?
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: I—
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Yes, you want the truth. You want to sweep his grave, and also to find the Sarcophagus.
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: But you met Talulah, and you met Eirene. You regret failing to discover Talulah's fall to evil, and you promised Eirene you'd never let it happen again.
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: Why? Do those things have anything to do with the truth of the Sarcophagus?
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: No, they don't. But they have to do with you. With 'Crownslayer' Lyudmila.
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: Think about it. What did your master say the last time you expressed your interest in Ursus?
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: She... she laughed.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: At your naivety.
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: She said: 'Lyudmila, killing an emperor honestly isn't much harder than killing a fowlbeast. If he bleeds, he can die.'
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: '...But what comes after taking his life?'
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: That's right. What comes after that?
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: Who will sit on the now-empty throne? Throw the nation into chaos—who will govern after? When a new tyrant ascends, will you kill again?
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: And will that spilled blood fill the hole in your heart?
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: You've never thought about these things. All you care about is the 'slaying'.
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: Because 'slaying' is easy. A discrete action with a defined endpoint. Blade goes in, target falls down. Mission accomplished.
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: It's the same with your trucker work. Deliver the goods, sign the papers. Mission accomplished.
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: You like that feeling. Hit the mark, and you don't have to care about whatever mess you leave behind. Never have to think about where to go next.
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: You reduced yourself to a blade, because blades don't have to think about the future.
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: ...And that's why I'm so lost.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Exactly. I know that the moment I set foot on that frozen soil, there's no way I'll stick to finding the so-called truth, or that it'll simply end with me crying at the laboratory ruins.
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: I grew up there. I know what life in Ursus is like. And as I followed Reunion, I saw how the people suffered.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: So it's impossible for me not to care about the locals. But what I fear most is that when I meet those people and see their situation, I'll still feel powerless.
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: Is my revenge only for father's misfortune? Is my anger only because I don't have the truth?
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: Can I still only tell myself I am the 'Crownslayer', that my blade exists only to topple the throne?
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Killing a king is so simple. Killing the crown though—well, that's a different story.
attributes.name: Lyudmila?

attributes.content: So I considered relying on Rhodes Island, or Reunion.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: I'm not hoping to use them as a shield. I'm hoping they can help me fight off the wind and snow of the tundra, together.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: But... obviously, I already know which answer I'll choose.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Lyudmila! Where have you been? You were missing all afternoon.
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: Look, the vodka you wanted! Not as good as the stuff in Ursus, but it's the best you can find in Siracusa.
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: Eirene.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Hm? What's up? Why so serious?
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: Did you decide to sign? Here, pen's all ready!
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: I'm leaving.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: To where? Did Rhodes Island call you back already?
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: No. It's my own decision.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: I'm returning to Ursus.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Now? But... it's cold up north.
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: Did we... let you down somehow? Or maybe those farmers—
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: Neither.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: You said you'd watch over me. You're breaking your promise.
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: It's because I've been watching you that I know how much effort you've put in to make the truckers' union what it is today.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: And what I learned from both you and that other person is that I can't expect someone else to achieve my goals for me. I need to take control of my life, from square one.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: ...It'll be a tough journey.
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: That's why I've been putting it off for so long.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: ...But you still have to go, don't you?
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: I have to.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Alright. I won't stop my homesick friend from going back.
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: But listen, Lyudmila. No matter what you find or fail to find there...
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: If you're ever tired, just remember that our door is always open. I'll keep the contract for you.
attributes.name: Eirene

attributes.content: It's a promise.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Who's there?
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: It's me.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: What? So you decided to come with us? Or are you here to see us off?
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: So what's up with 'Susie's Groceries'?
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: ...Borrowed the name of a friend.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: You've changed, too.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: I'll help you guys deliver this batch to the border.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: ...Why?
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Call it paying my fare in advance. And also... I need to return the final favor I owe Reunion.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Sure.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: So where are you headed?
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: To Rhodes Island to collect my luggage, and then to Ursus.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Alone?
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Alone.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Then we might actually meet again.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: If the opportunity presents itself.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Lyudmila enters the meeting room to find Kal'tsit waiting for her.
This time she speaks first.
You're hiding a lot of things from me, aren't you?
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: What I deem it necessary to, yes.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: So you'll only tell me what you think I should know, right?
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: I won't deny that.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: Then I don't need you.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Regardless, Rhodes Island will not permit you to go to Ursus.
attributes.name: Kal'tsit

attributes.content: I'm just visiting my old home. I was born there.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: I'll go alone. Neither you or Rhodes Island can stop me from walking there on my own two legs. You don't have the right.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: I'll take a look, maybe do some things.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: I might even meet some of your operators there, but we'll see.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: That's all.
attributes.name: Lyudmila

attributes.content: Her speech done, she does not look back as she leaves.
Kal'tsit does not stop her.

attributes.text: Dad, I'm obviously no navigator or politician.
\nBut I can become the fog traversing through wind and snow. So this time, I'll see for myself what lies past the frost.
